$comment: Single source of truth for classification, shared by the SEO skills (seo/rules.py) and the 'PBS - SEO Rankings' sheet. Ported from the sheet's Rules and Keyword Setup tabs on 2026-10-30. Regexes must stay portable (Python re, JavaScript, RE2): no lookarounds or backreferences. In every rule list the first match wins.

query_categories.default_note: Queries no rule matches (and not tracked) count as Generic and are listed as unclassified, to review.

rules.note: Checked first so brand queries never fall into other categories.
Holidays and calendar. Checked early so 'bank holiday' doesn't count as Bank account.
Tax residency. Checked before Residency so it stays in Tax.
Residence permits and visas (EN/RU). Before IE, so 'внж по ип' counts here.

rules.regex: individual entrepreneur|sole proprietor|sole trader|индивидуальн|предпринимател|(^| )(ип|ie)( |$)|мал[а-я]* бизнес|small business
rules.note: Includes small business status (an IE regime). Matches 'ип' and 'ie' only as whole words, so 'ипотека' is not caught.
Accounting and audit. Lawyer searches are in a later rule.
Before Company, so 'corporate tax' counts as Tax.
Before Company and Bank account, so 'llc new payment system' counts here.
Apostille and document legalisation.
Marriage registration and weddings for foreigners.
Generic 'llc' queries (e.g. US states) also land here.
Bank accounts and banks. Includes Chinese (银行, 开户) and Russian typed on an English keyboard (,fyr = бан).
After Tax, so 'property tax' counts as Tax. Before the lawyer rule, so real estate lawyer searches count here.
Lawyer and legal-services searches. After the other services, so 'юрист по недвижимости' counts under that service.

rules.regex: 2026|район|district|areas? (of|in) tbilisi|дигоми|сабуртало|ваке|cost of living|стоимость жизни|сколько стоит жи|дорого ли жить|yaşam maliyeti|pahal|ucuz|fiyat|(^| )rent|аренд|коворкинг|cowork|weather|погод|temperature|insurance|страхов|ค่าครองชีพ|въезд|посольств|embassy|travel|universit|университет|alte univ|(^| )alte( |$)|(^| )seu( |$)|тгу|üniversite|جامعة
rules.note: Searches with 2026, living in Georgia, travel and universities. After the service categories, so 'ип в грузии 2026' stays in IE.
One path per language: EN, RU, AR, ZH.
One path per language: EN, RU, AR, ZH.
Root and language home pages (/ru/, /ar/, /zh/).

page_languages.default_note: Any page without a language folder.

rules.note: Pages under /ru/.
Pages under /ar/.
Pages under /zh/.

channels.default_note: Anything that matches no rule (email, social, untagged links).

rules.note: Visits from AI chat tools. Checked first, so 'chatgpt.com / referral' counts here. grok, meta.ai, mistral and you.com added from the skills' former ai_sources list.
Unpaid search results: Google, Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo.
Google Ads and Yandex Direct.
Typed address, bookmarks, untracked apps.
Links from other websites.

proven.note: Service searches with the most clicks.

opportunity.note: Service searches with the most impressions while ranking just below the top results.

generic.note: Generic searches with the most clicks.

auto.exclude_note: Never picked as Proven or Opportunity: years, quotes, bank names, visa-free travel.
auto.ignored_words_note: Duplicate check: these words are ignored and words are compared by their first 5 letters, so 'внж по ип в грузии' duplicates 'внж грузии по ип'.
auto.category_caps_note: Max automatic picks (Proven + Opportunity) per service category. Categories not listed (Brand, Generic, unclassified) are never picked as Proven or Opportunity.

keywords.tracked_note: target_page = the page that should rank for the keyword. Proposed 2026-10-30 from 90 days of Search Console data: the page already ranking in the top 10 (≥10 impressions, homepage excluded), else the service page for the keyword's language and category. Edit freely.
